model: ROLEX Oyster Perpetual 36 126000 (36 mm steel, lavender dial, Oyster bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Oyster Perpetual 36 126000, an adaptation of the Oyster Perpetual 41 template (same step, smaller case): case and lugs from the photo silhouette, smooth domed polished bezel, domed crystal, baton hands and a seconds needle, fluted crown and the three-column Oyster bracelet (outer / centre / outer) at the photo's joints; the dial, indices, print, minute track and the photographed hands come from one native photo map. Native 1920 x 2857 photo, 22.806 px/mm, no texture scaling.

case.note: the case outline follows the photo silhouette (lug top y 956 = 20.52 mm, lug bottom y 1936 = 22.45 mm); the slab slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: smooth domed polished bezel (no insert, no numerals): fractions of bezel_in..bezel_out (15.54..17.61 mm) from the inner edge to the outer edge

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, from perpendicular edge scans on the photo (the silhouette includes the black side facet) plus 0.03 mm so the 3D hands hide the photographed ones; the last point sits at the measured length (flat tips). The lume strips and black facets stay in the projected photo. Hands and hub use the hands_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: plain fluted Rolex crown, no guards: neck x 1360..1370, flutes to x 1407, rounded cap to 1424 (coronet is texture)

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind

bracelet.note: Oyster bracelet: brushed outer links and a wider centre link. Joints (px, 22.806 px/mm, pivot (960, 1424)): outer top 811.5, bottom 2108.5 / 2292 / 2414.5; centre top 770.5 / 931, bottom 1957 / 2166.5 / 2335 / 2435.5; ends y 729..731 (top) and 2469 (bottom). The photo's own dark lines and shading stay in the projected texture. Column x lines about 860.5 / 1058.5 px (top), 859.5..862.5 / 1056.5..1060.5 (bottom). The centre column starts at the bezel inner edge; outer pieces start at the case tips. Outer link edges come from the alpha silhouette.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
